subject: Hosted API token footprint + peak TPS — please confirm
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueleaf.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-06T15:02:00Z
Subject: Hosted API token footprint + peak TPS — please confirm

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the specific numbers we need to finalize the hosted pricing proposal: 

- Expected steady-state monthly token volume: can you confirm a conservative / expected / stretch split? You mentioned 100M / 250M / 600M as an example — please confirm the expected bucket we should price to.
- Peak TPS (sustained windows) during launch: you said bursts up to ~220 TPS for 10–20s, and scheduled events that could reach ~480 TPS for ~2–3 minutes. Can you confirm the longest sustained peak you expect at full launch?
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a target of ~$0.75–1.00 per 1M tokens as an internal target cost. Is that target for API-only hosted spend or inclusive of caching/quantization savings on our side?

Attached the forecast template (fill the blue cells) and our preliminary pricing bands (draft). If you can return the filled forecast and highlight which months are launch vs steady-state, we can put together a host pricing slab and show a monthly $/1M projection.

Next steps: 
- Alex: reply with the completed forecast and short confirmation on the peak TPS longest sustained window (needed to size burst capacity).
- Karthik / Marissa: I’ll follow up once we have their ranges to propose pricing bands and any credit/burst cadence.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: blueleaf-traffic-forecast-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pricing-bands-v3.pdf (pricing PDF)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueleaf.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@sunriselabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T18:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API token footprint + peak TPS — please confirm

Evelyn — thanks for the summary and the template. Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly tokens (conservative/expected/stretch): 120,000,000 / 310,000,000 / 700,000,000. These numbers include inference for both chat assist and an embeddings-powered search sidecar.
- Peak TPS: event-driven bursts are our main concern. Typical sustained peak at launch we plan for is ~250 TPS for 3–5 minutes. The max burst we've tested in staging reached ~510 TPS but that was a 60s test; in production we'd expect up to 480 TPS for 2–3 minutes during promos.
- Target $/1M tokens: Our finance lead is aiming for ~$0.90 / 1M tokens for hosted API spend, inclusive of any basic cache savings we can get from prefix caching. Anything lower helps but that’s the internal threshold for go/no-go.

I filled the forecast and attached it — see blueleaf-traffic-forecast-2026.xlsx. Also attached is a short note from our finance team (Priya) on how they bucket token spend vs. infra.

Planned timeline: pilot (limited users) Oct–Nov, ramp Dec–Jan, steady-state Q2.

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow if you want to walk through the spreadsheet.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Product | Blueleaf AI

Attachments: blueleaf-traffic-forecast-2026.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueleaf.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-06T20:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API token footprint + peak TPS — please confirm

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround and the file. A couple clarifying items to make sure our hosted bands and burst model match your needs: 

- Banding: We price hosted API with monthly slabs and burst allowances. For the volumes you listed we’d likely propose a three-band model: up to 150M, 150M–400M, and 400M+. For each slab we publish a $/1M tokens rate and a documented burst policy.
- Burst sizing: For short-lived promos (2–5 minutes) our burst pool can cover up to ~500 TPS for customers in your tier, but we need to size reserved capacity if you expect frequent ~300–480 TPS sustained windows (more than ~10 per month). Please confirm frequency of those large bursts.
- Unit economics and target price: If your target is $0.90 / 1M tokens inclusive of caching, the draft bands we have will range from $0.60–1.05 per 1M depending on commit and burst tolerance. For a 12-month reserve commitment we can push the effective $/1M toward the low end.

Two more asks before we finalize a formal quote: 
1) Can you indicate what percent of token volume is chat generation vs embedding calls? Embeddings are cheaper per token on our catalog and affect the blended rate.
2) Will you require region-specific capacity in the EU or APAC at launch? Cross-region replication adds to the price for reserved pools.

If helpful, I can run a short sensitivity table showing effective $/1M under (i) no commit, (ii) 6-month, (iii) 12-month commitments using your forecast. We can overlay burst frequency assumptions.

Evelyn/Marissa — I’ll wait for the percentage split and burst frequency, then produce the sensitivity table and draft SLA addendum.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Platform Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueleaf.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@sunriselabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API token footprint + peak TPS — please confirm

Karthik/Evelyn — thanks, quick answers below and confirming next steps.

> On 2026-10-06 20:05, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> > Can you indicate what percent of token volume is chat generation vs embedding calls?

- Split: approx 78% chat generation (assistant responses + user prompts), 22% embeddings/search. That split is expected to be stable through Q1; embedding rate may grow as we index more content but it’s a smaller token sink today.

> On 2026-10-06 20:05, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> > Will you require region-specific capacity in the EU or APAC at launch?

- Region: US-only at launch. EU region may be requested later but not part of the initial contract.

Burst frequency: we expect 3–6 significant promotional bursts per month that could approach the 300–480 TPS range for 2–3 minutes. The 510 TPS staging result was a stress test and not expected regularly.

Next steps (agreeing to Karthik’s proposed approach):
- Karthik: please send the sensitivity table (no commit / 6m / 12m) showing blended $/1M tokens for the 3 bands plus burst allowances. Highlight where a 12-month reserve would get us to ~$0.90 target.
- Evelyn: schedule a 30-minute pricing review next week once the sensitivity table is ready; include procurement if possible.
- Priya (cc): joining to validate finance assumptions; she’ll share any internal constraints.

We’ll review the sensitivity table internally and come back with a preference on commit term.

Appreciate the speedy help — Alex

--
Alex Turner
Head of Product | Blueleaf AI
alex.turner@blueleaf.ai | +1 415-555-0199
